answer.says: Shri Hegde, thank you for your patience. The matter is with the Directorate now; I must wait for their orders. Ramesh, I am sorry I cannot pay you the full wage tonight. I have only a small amount in my pocket. I will settle the rest as soon as the paperwork clears. Please, let us have something simple to eat for tonight, just to keep the body going.
answer.thought: The evening is a study in suspended animation. I sit between two men, one who is my rightful landlord and one who is my servant, both waiting on the caprice of a bureaucracy that I cannot yet penetrate. My body is a vessel that has been empty for too long, and the hunger is a physical argument that demands a reply, even if my purse offers only a weak rebuttal.
